Subject: Introduction - {PERSON:single@1} <> {PERSON:single@2}

Hi {PERSON:single@1} and {PERSON:single@2},

I would like to introduce you both. {PERSON:full@1} runs operations at {ORG:company} in {LOC:city}, and {PERSON:full@2} leads sales at {ORG:company}.

{PERSON:single@1}, you can reach {PERSON:single@2} at {EMAIL:of2} or on {PHONE}.
{PERSON:single@2}, {PERSON:single@1} is on {PHONE} and {URL}.

I will leave you to it. Let me know if the call on {DATE:any} works.

Cheers,
{PERSON:ordinary_word}

arre {PERSON:single@1} are you there?
yes {PERSON:single@2} bolo
{PERSON:single@1}: can you send the gst number of {ORG:company}?
{PERSON:single@2}: {GSTIN}
{PERSON:single@1}: thanks. and {PERSON:single@3} bhai ka upi?
{PERSON:single@2}: {UPI}
{PERSON:single@1}: ok will pay {MONEY} today evening
{PERSON:single@2}: {PERSON:single@3} bol raha tha office {LOC:area} mein hai ab

Call transcript - {DATE:long}

Agent: Thank you for calling {ORG:company}, this is {PERSON:single@1}. How can I help?
Caller: Hi {PERSON:single@1}, I'm {PERSON:full@2} from {ORG:company}. My number is {PHONE}.
Agent: Could you confirm your registered email?
Caller: It's {EMAIL:of2}.
Agent: Thanks {PERSON:honorific@2}. I can see your GSTIN {GSTIN} on file and the order {NEG:order}.
Caller: Yes. The goods went to {ADDRESS}.
Agent: Understood. Your balance is {MONEY}. I will email the statement and call you on {PHONE} tomorrow.
Caller: Okay. Also note the server at {IP} that I mentioned is down.
